description: HTTP check status, timing breakdown and status codes (F07).

list.name: check
list.label: Check
list.query:
SELECT device_name || ' / ' || name AS __text, check_id::text AS __value
  FROM check_states_v WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND plugin = 'http' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS device, name AS check, status, since, last_result_at, last_output
  FROM check_states_v WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND plugin = 'http'
 ORDER BY status = 'OK', device_name, name

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT c.device_name || ' / ' || c.name FROM check_states_v c WHERE c.check_id = m.check_id) AS metric, avg(value) AS value
  FROM metrics_raw m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'total_ms' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms < 300000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT c.device_name || ' / ' || c.name FROM check_states_v c WHERE c.check_id = m.check_id) AS metric, sum(sum) / sum(count) AS value
  FROM metrics_5m m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'total_ms' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 300000 AND $__interval_ms < 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT c.device_name || ' / ' || c.name FROM check_states_v c WHERE c.check_id = m.check_id) AS metric, sum(sum) / sum(count) AS value
  FROM metrics_1h m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'total_ms' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
